title: A queued run whose project was removed does not start
lead: S05 (landed 67521b0) admits a queued run in startQueuedLocked (internal/daemon/runs.go:352-387) using hasRoomLocked (:326-350). When the run's project is no longer in the registry, hasRoomLocked finds no project (find, handlers.go:135) and applies no project cap, so the run starts. Noted in the S05 run report.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A run of a project that is no longer registered starts with no per-project cap and with a runDeps and project that the registry no longer describes.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/daemon/runs.go`: startQueuedLocked and hasRoomLocked.
- `internal/daemon/runs_test.go`: a test beside the S05 wave tests.
- Related: S38 (projects rm refuses while the project has unfinished runs) removes the usual way to reach this state. Check its state before running this slice.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A queued run whose project is removed from the registry while the daemon runs is not started and shows why (proposed; see Implement).
- The S05 tests still pass.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Not specified. Open points for the owner, to settle with `adj ask` before this slice runs: (a) whether this slice is still needed once S38 lands, since S38 stops `ork projects rm` from removing a project with unfinished runs (a hand edit of projects.json still reaches it); (b) what the run does: stay queued, or stop with a reason.

Decided 2026-10-23 (owner interview): keep this slice: a queued run whose project is no longer registered stops with the reason 'project was removed'. Nothing is open.
